projectDescription: A full-stack Two-Echelon Vehicle Routing Problem (2E-VRP) solver that optimizes multi-vehicle delivery routes with driving and last-mile walking segments, powered by Google OR-Tools and OpenRouteService.
keyFeatures: Two-Echelon VRP (2E-VRP) optimization using Google OR-Tools with capacity constraints and optional node penalties
Automatic hub generation via K-Means clustering to create intermediate parking/depot points
Real-world route geometry via OpenRouteService for both driving (vehicles) and walking (last-mile) segments
Interactive map powered by Leaflet/React-Leaflet with draggable customer markers and color-coded vehicle routes
Address geocoding through Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) with city/country scoping
CSV import/export for nodes and vehicles, plus downloadable routing result tables
Proximity assignment: customers within 0.25 km of a parking station are served on foot from that hub
Route statistics panel with per-vehicle driving/walking summaries, stop timelines, and Google Maps deep links
publicApiSurface: GET /stations — list EZ Parking hub stations
GET /geocode?q={address} — geocode an address via Nominatim
POST /optimize-routes — solve the 2E-VRP and return optimized routes with geometry
VRPRequest model: { nodes: Node[], vehicles: Vehicle[], stations: Station[], use_auto_hubs: bool }
Node model: { id, name, address?, lat, lng, load, working_time, nearby_node_id? }
Vehicle model: { id, name, capacity, fixed_cost }
Station model: { id, name, lat, lng }
solve_vrp(distance_matrix, vehicles, depot, demands, penalty, max_route_distance)
determine_nearby_stations(nodes, stations, radius_km) → nodes with nearby_node_id
generate_hubs(nodes, stations, num_hubs) → auto-generated hub stations
get_vehicle_route_geometry(route_nodes, all_nodes) → driving segments with polylines
get_walking_route_geometry(parking, nearby_nodes) → walking segments with polylines
